import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, θ, p, q, n, ã, t̃):
        p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)
        q = np.asarray(q, dtype=np.float64)
        n = np.asarray(n, dtype=np.float64)
        ã = np.asarray(ã, dtype=np.float64)
        t̃ = np.asarray(t̃, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = p.shape[0]
        assert np.ndim(θ) == 0
        assert p.shape == (dim_0, 3, )
        assert q.shape == (dim_0, 3, )
        assert n.shape == (dim_0, 3, )
        assert ã.shape == (3,)
        assert t̃.shape == (3,)
        # b = ∑_i cos(θ)²((p_i - q_i)⋅n_i +((p_i+q_i)×n_i)⋅ã+n_i⋅t̃)²
        sum_0 = 0
        for i in range(1, len(n)+1):
            sum_0 += np.power(np.asarray(np.cos(θ), dtype=np.float64), 2) * np.power(np.asarray((np.dot(((p[i-1] - q[i-1])).ravel(), (n[i-1]).ravel()) + np.dot(((np.cross((p[i-1] + q[i-1]), n[i-1]))).ravel(), (ã).ravel()) + np.dot((n[i-1]).ravel(), (t̃).ravel())), dtype=np.float64), 2)
        self.b = sum_0
